title: Safety and efficacy of 0.02% and 0.01% atropine on controlling myopia progression: a 2-year clinical trial

groups.description: atropine 0.02% once nightly in both eyes with best-corrected single-vision spectacles, double-masked randomisation between 0.01% and 0.02%; Zhengzhou, China; 138 enrolled, 105 completed 2 years (Table 1 completers; mean age of completers)
atropine 0.01% once nightly in both eyes with best-corrected single-vision spectacles; Zhengzhou, China; 142 enrolled, 106 completed 2 years (Table 1 completers; mean age of completers)

single-vision spectacles only, children who chose no atropine at the randomisation visit (not randomised); Zhengzhou, China; 120 enrolled, 89 completed 2 years (Table 1 completers; mean age of completers)

exclusions.what: Table 2 baseline means (95% CI), 24-month changes and change differences
exclusions.reason: generalized additive mixed-model estimates (slopes per month) and confidence intervals are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)
interval change from 12 to 24 months, not from baseline

exclusions.what: Table 4 control rates of SER progression and AL elongation (%)
exclusions.reason: derived percentages between groups, not axial length

exclusions.what: Table 4 rows of other studies (Chia, Yam, Larkin, Wei, Clark, Moon, Joachimsen, Sacchi)
exclusions.reason: values of other studies, not this study's groups
baseline values only of children lost to follow-up; no follow-up axial length tabulated for them

exclusions.what: Table 1 SER, IOP, pupil diameter, accommodation, ACD, corneal curvature and astigmatism; Table 3 accommodation amplitude and pupil diameter
Proportions of children progressing by less than 1.0 D or more than 2.0 D (Results text); Fig 2 plots
exclusions.reason: proportions and figures are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)

notes: Clinical trial ChiCTR-IPD-16008844, First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, China: 400 children enrolled (138 atropine 0.02%, 142 atropine 0.01%, 120 single-vision control by choice); 64 lost in year 1, 336 continued, 300 completed 2 years (105, 106, 89).
The tabulated analysis set is the 2-year completers in every group (Table 1); per-group enrolment is reported (abstract, Fig 1), and each group keeps at least 70% of its enrolled children.

The 12-month changes are taken from Table 4 for the same analysis set as the 24-month changes (they add up with the 12-24 interval change); the article does not state the 12-month analysis set separately.
Refraction, pupil diameter, accommodation and other biometry are tabulated but are not axial length.
